body: WHAT WAS UNDER TEST. C1/VGA: the gate set is the items where the deployed top-20 rank-weighted signed-cosine vote and the F95 adjudication DISAGREE (computable at inference with no label, hence deployable, not an oracle); the gate target is 'is adjudication right here (a FIX) or is the deployed vote right (a BREAK)'; emission = adjudicated label iff the gate fires, deployed vote otherwise. Because the switch is a no-op on agreement items BY CONSTRUCTION, F95's control-2b shape cost is priced to EXACTLY ZERO off the gate set -- that structural discharge of F95's ban clause (c) was C1's whole distinctness argument. C2/VNQ: read the verifier's neighbourhood-quality profile as a SELECTIVE-PREDICTION risk ordering over the DEPLOYED vote's own errors (AUGRC, Traub et al. arXiv:2407.01032, lower better; implementation verified against hand-computed 0.2500/0.3333 on a 4-item case and ordered perfect-detector < random < perfect-anti-detector). || PROVENANCE, and why a regeneration was needed: LITSWEEP6_RELGEN sec0(a) is correct and was independently verified -- the F95 pair-score matrices are NOT BANKED (mechnov_pairverify.py contains zero np.save/torch.save; only per-cell summary JSON survives), and S[query, bank] plus every per-item fixed/broken identity -- exactly what C1's gate target and C2's risk ordering are made of -- was computed in memory and discarded. The prescribed remedy was followed verbatim: the frozen arms module was NOT edited to add persistence; a NEW emitter imports it unmodified and replays the frozen fused-space PRIMARY cell fold by fold, reusing its own build_space/l2n/all_unordered_pairs/pair_features/fit_mlp/predict_mlp and EVERY frozen constant. ONE efficiency deviation, disclosed: F95 scored every (held-out x in-fold) pair, the emitter scores only the 20 NOMINATED candidates per query -- bit-identical because the frozen MLP is a deterministic pointwise function and fit set, PCA, standardisation, seeds and folds are all bit-identical -- and this is ASSERTED, not argued, by the parity gate. || PARITY 78/78 (26 frozen F95 quantities per dataset, 4dp, hard asserts that abort): acc/mF1/posrate of the deployed vote, of the cosine-shape control 2b, of mlp_max and mlp_mean3; n_deployed_wrong; n_pathology_pop; median_sc_rank_all; median_sc_rank_deployed_wrong; and fixed/broke/net/exchange_rate/pathology_fixed for BOTH aggregations. Beyond the asserted set the per-fold PCA explained-variance sequences reproduce F95 fold for fold and the fitted-pair counts (150000 / 106953 / 96141) match. Runtime 67.3 / 47.9 / 42.4 s per dataset on <=8 threads. TWO MACHINERY ENDPOINTS also check out: the fire_all reference (fire on every gate-set item = UNGATED F95 adjudication) returns -0.0040 / -0.0466 / -0.0146, reproducing F95 sec3.2's primary-cell deltas exactly, and the oracle reference returns +0.0726 / +0.0535 / +0.0893, reproducing the sweep record's ceilings exactly. MINOR ERRATUM against F95, recorded for provenance rather than carried: F95 sec3.4 says PCA retains '0.9459-0.9842 of key variance ... in every cell'; the true MINIMUM over the 45 per-fold values is 0.9442 (HateMM x fused x fold 2) -- 0.9459 is the max of that cell, not the min over cells. A bound misstatement in a provenance sentence, not a result. || THE ARITHMETIC THE BARS WERE CALIBRATED AGAINST, RECOMPUTED (not transcribed) and matching the sweep record exactly: HateMM n=744, gate set N=111, 54 fixed / 57 broken, fix base rate 0.4865, oracle ceiling +0.0726, break-even precision 0.6005; MHC-ZH n=579, N=89, 31/58, 0.3483, +0.0535, 0.5976; MHC-EN n=549, N=106, 49/57, 0.4623, +0.0893, 0.5777. || POSITIVE CONTROL RUN BEFORE THE FREEZE, SYNTHETIC ONLY (so a null below is a property of the data, not of the code): at the real problem's scale (n=700, N_gate=110, base rate 0.47) an arm where fix/break IS a function of the features returns +0.0571 (logistic, precision 0.8448, permutation p=0.0164) and +0.0543 (gbm), while a pure-noise-feature arm returns an honest -0.0129 / -0.0043 with p = 0.8852 / 0.5410. || NESTING AND OPERATING POINT: for each outer F95 fold the gate is fitted ONLY on gate-set items outside it; an INNER StratifiedKFold(5, random_state=17) produces out-of-sample scores; the threshold maximising NET GAIN on those inner scores is chosen (with +inf = fire on nothing, net 0, always a candidate and ties resolved conservatively); the gate is refitted on the whole pool and that inner-chosen threshold applied to the outer fold. THE GATE NEVER SEES THE FOLD IT SCORES AND NO THRESHOLD IS EVER CHOSEN ON AN EVALUATED FOLD. Gate models logistic (PRIMARY, low capacity at N=89-111) and shallow GBM (SECONDARY); to block cross-dataset model shopping, K-VGA-1 had to be met by ONE AND THE SAME model on >=2 of 3 datasets. Permutation null: N_PERM=200, PERM_SEED=12345, targets shuffled WITHIN THE FITTING POOL ONLY, full nested pipeline including threshold selection re-run per permutation -- i.e. at the SAME fitting budget, as K-VGA-2 requires. || K-VGA-1 (net >= +0.030 acc on >=2/3 datasets, fold signs >=4/5) -- FAIL, 0 of 3, MISSED BY A FACTOR OF THREE. Verifier gate, PRIMARY adjudicator: HateMM logistic 48/111 fired, gate precision 0.4375 vs 0.7325 REQUIRED at that fire count, Dacc -0.0081, signs 00-+-; HateMM gbm 88/111, 0.5455 vs 0.6268, +0.0108, 0+0+0; MHC-ZH logistic AND gbm both fired on 0/89 in every fold (an honest conservative outcome -- the inner folds offered no threshold with positive net gain), Dacc +0.0000; MHC-EN logistic 46/106, 0.3696 vs 0.6790, -0.0219, -----; MHC-EN gbm 45/106, 0.5111 vs 0.6830, +0.0018, +-+-+. Best verifier number anywhere in the primary read: +0.0108. Best number in the ENTIRE 36-cell battery: +0.0296 -- still under bar, on the SECONDARY mean-top-3 adjudicator, and it is a CONTROL arm not a verifier arm. ARITHMETIC POINT WORTH KEEPING: the break-even precisions 0.5777-0.6005 assume firing on the WHOLE gate set; every arm that actually fires does so on 3-79% of it, and partial coverage RAISES the required precision to 0.63-0.79 for arms firing on >=30 items. The closest approach anywhere is f47ctrl_full:gbm on HateMM at precision 0.6923 against 0.7146 required. || K-VGA-2 (beat the label-shuffled null) -- FAIL for the PRIMARY arm on all three: p = 0.8706 (HateMM logistic) / 0.5174 (ZH) / 0.9751 (EN). The GBM verifier arm clears its null on HateMM (p = 0.0100) but at +0.0108, a third of the bar, and does not replicate on ZH or EN (p = 0.3632 / 0.1841). || K-VGA-3 (new-signal control, mandatory) -- FIRES, AND THIS IS THE DECISIVE RESULT. The frozen bar: an arm whose gate uses F47 FEATURES ONLY (vote margin, purity, sub-votes, NO verifier anywhere); if it MATCHES the verifier gate, the 'new information source' argument that unlocks F47 is REFUTED and the direction dies REGARDLESS OF NET. It does not merely match -- IT BEATS the verifier gate on ALL THREE datasets: HateMM best verifier +0.0108 vs f47ctrl_full:gbm +0.0269 (signs +++++, permutation p = 0.0050), delta +0.0161; MHC-ZH +0.0000 vs f47ctrl_full:logistic +0.0104 (signs ++0+-, p = 0.0050), delta +0.0104; MHC-EN +0.0018 vs f47ctrl_full:logistic +0.0182 (signs +-+0+, p = 0.0100), delta +0.0164. The inversion is SHARPEST WHERE IT MATTERS MOST: on the two datasets where the PRIMARY verifier gate is statistically DEAD (p = 0.5174, 0.9751), the F47-only control is SIGNIFICANT against the same null at the same fitting budget. The gate signal on the disagreement set is REAL and permutation-validated -- and it is carried by vote margin, purity, neighbour statistics and cross-channel sub-vote disagreement, i.e. UNSUPERVISED functions of the cosine ordering, NOT by the trained relation profile. The control was budget-matched by design (6 features vs the verifier's 6; the 10-feature f47ctrl_full is the declared generosity check) precisely so an over-parameterised control could not flatter the verifier arm. This falsifies a pre-registered falsifiable claim: LITSWEEP6_RELGEN sec2 C1 called the distinctness argument 'the load-bearing one ... pre-registered as falsifiable'. It has been falsified. || K-VGA-4 (class balance within 0.10 of bank rate) -- PASS, max deviation 0.0892 (bank 0.4005/0.3109/0.3060 vs emitted 0.4489 & 0.3790 / 0.3489 & 0.3489 / 0.2168 & 0.2659). No arm collapses. UNLIKE F95's logistic arm (which collapsed to positive rate 0.0237-0.0604 and made its nulls uninterpretable), THE NULLS HERE ARE INTERPRETABLE -- which is what licenses reading K-VGA-2's non-significance as a real null rather than an artefact. || C2/VNQ -- FAILS BOTH BARS, AND LOSES TO THE CHEAPEST POSSIBLE BASELINE. AUGRC (lower better) / AUROC(error detection): HateMM VNQ 0.0458 / 0.7451, kNN-UE 0.0429 / 0.7674, PLAIN VOTE MARGIN 0.0465 / 0.7395, VNQ raw scalar |s1-s0| 0.0687 / 0.5708; MHC-ZH VNQ 0.0417 / 0.7668, kNN-UE 0.0393 / 0.7860, plain margin 0.0384 / 0.7927, raw scalar 0.0553 / 0.6615; MHC-EN VNQ 0.0810 / 0.6713, kNN-UE 0.0758 / 0.7012, plain margin 0.0696 / 0.7375, raw scalar 0.0891 / 0.6238. K-VNQ-1 (beat kNN-UE on >=2/3, signs >=4/5) FAIL 0 of 3: DAUGRC -0.0029 (2/5 folds) / -0.0024 (1/5) / -0.0052 (1/5) -- VNQ is WORSE than the kNN-UE distance+label-ratio baseline on EVERY dataset. K-VNQ-2 (must also beat the plain vote margin) FAIL: +0.0007 (HateMM, 3/5 folds, positive but under the 4/5 requirement) / -0.0033 (ZH, 2/5) / -0.0114 (EN, 2/5) -- 1 of 3 and that one misses the fold bar. THIS IS THE SWEEP RECORD'S OWN EXPECTATION INVERTED: it predicted 'technically this probably passes ... it would be surprising if none of that showed up in a risk ordering'. NONE OF IT SHOWED UP. The mechanism is now legible and is the SAME ONE F95 sec3.2b found: SEPARATING SAME-CLASS FROM DIFFERENT-CLASS PAIRS IS A DIFFERENT QUESTION FROM KNOWING WHETHER THE VOTE IS ABOUT TO BE WRONG. The verifier is much better at the first (+0.16 to +0.23 within-query AUC, F95 control 1) and no better at the second. Selective prediction was the ONE axis in this sweep that did not have to fight the exchange-rate law; it did not have to, and it lost anyway, for an independent reason. || THE ONE GENUINELY NEW POSITIVE DATUM, RECORDED AND EXPLICITLY NOT PROMOTED. There IS a real, permutation-validated gating signal on the disagreement set: f47ctrl_full reaches +0.0269 (HateMM, p = 0.0050, fold signs +++++), +0.0104 (ZH, p = 0.0050) and +0.0182 (EN, p = 0.0100). This is a genuine REFINEMENT OF F47'S EPITAPH -- F47's features are dead as a per-item CHANNEL SELECTOR but are NOT dead as a per-item ADJUDICATION GATE. It is nonetheless (i) BELOW the +0.030 bar on all three datasets, (ii) measured in RAW TRAIN-SPLIT space where F66's selection lock and the campaign's F47/F89 history both say conversion is the failing step, and (iii) decisively, it is a gate on an adjudicator (F95's) that is NET-NEGATIVE UNGATED on all three datasets, with a family oracle ceiling of only +0.0726/+0.0535/+0.0893. IT IS AN ANALYSIS DATUM, NOT A LEVER, AND MUST NOT BE PROMOTED AS ONE. || VERDICT KILL, both candidates, 5 of 6 frozen bars (K-VGA-1 FAIL, K-VGA-2 FAIL, K-VGA-3 FIRES, K-VGA-4 PASS, K-VNQ-1 FAIL, K-VNQ-2 FAIL). C1 dies twice over and the SECOND death is the informative one: K-VGA-1 is merely missed, but K-VGA-3 CLOSES THE AXIS rather than failing to open it -- measured head to head at identical fitting budget, nesting, operating-point rule and permutation null, the F47 features are STRICTLY BETTER gating features than the verifier profile on all three datasets. The verifier profile is not a new information source for this decision; it is a WORSE one. || ROUTING / BANS (measured, not argued): do NOT spend GPU, do NOT promote to ceremony, and specifically do NOT re-propose (a) any VERIFIER-PROFILE GATE, SELECTOR or ROUTER over this decision -- K-VGA-3 closes it by measurement; (b) VERIFIER-BASED SELECTIVE PREDICTION / ABSTENTION / RISK ORDERING -- K-VNQ-1/2 close it and the FREE vote margin dominates it; (c) 'a better gate model' -- the binding constraint is the FEATURE SOURCE, and the control that beats it is already in the dead F47 family. || WHAT IS NOW SETTLED: THE RELATIONAL ASSET IS ANALYSIS-GRADE ONLY, exactly as LITSWEEP6_RELGEN sec5 PRE-COMMITTED ('If C1 fails, the relational asset is settled as analysis-grade only, and the campaign should stop trying to convert it'). Three independent conversion attempts have now been made on it -- F95 (replace the vote), C1 (gate the replacement), C2 (read it as risk) -- and ALL THREE ARE NEGATIVE. The recommended paper framing is unchanged and now better supported: relgen C3 (VEA, evidence ranking for the audit pillar) remains the ONE legal, unmeasured use of the verifier, and F95's binding 'NEVER an accuracy claim' should be carried verbatim. C4 (VSW) was not tasked and was not run; note only that the emitter now exists, so C4's lambda-sweep exchange-rate curve is a much cheaper rider than when the sweep record priced it. || CONTEXT -- THE LITSWEEP-6 3-LANE SWEEP RECORDS ARE COMMITTED: refine-logs/LITSWEEP6_MEMBANK.md (62efd82, 5 ranked bank/vote candidates, ALL $0/CPU pregates with 0 GPU-h full versions -- a first for this campaign), LITSWEEP6_PARADIGM.md (49e15ec) and LITSWEEP6_RELGEN.md (f62e777). THE PARADIGM LANE'S ORGANIZING FACT, which F97 now makes a fourth-and-fifth confirmation of: RANKING QUALITY >> DECISION QUALITY on four independent measurements -- F95 (verifier beats cosine by +0.13 to +0.27 pair-AUC, 18/18 cells, 4.3-8.8x over bar, yet 0/36 end-to-end), W4 temporal (research-wiki/EVAL_temporal_memory_W4.md: EN temporal-split ROC 0.8484 ABOVE the random-split reference 0.7175 while macro-F1 DROPS -0.084), F88 ERRPAT (correct analogue at median rank ~1.5, then out-voted; errors are CONFIDENT inversions ~90% seed-invariant), and F50/F48 (AUC 0.898, 'unconvertible'). OUR SYSTEM RANKS MUCH BETTER THAN IT DECIDES, EVERYWHERE WE HAVE MEASURED IT, and every dead direction tried to close that gap with a better UNIFORM DECISION RULE over the same scores (vote operators F89, k F94, thresholds F88, losses F75, verifiers F95, now gates F97) -- that axis is closed from SIX directions. The paradigm lane's RECOMMENDATION is therefore not another rule: CHANGE THE OUTPUT OBJECT so that ranking quality is what gets cashed in -- a THREE-WAY CERTIFIED OUTPUT {hate, non-hate, refer} with a distribution-free risk budget (R1, relational nonconformity, $0 pregate fully banked) and an OPERATING POINT THAT IS A POLICY rather than a constant (R2, anytime-valid drift-adaptive, anchored on our own W4 temporal measurement). BOTH REQUIRE A USER STORY RULING FIRST: neither satisfies '+3 acc on >=2 datasets' at full coverage, BY CONSTRUCTION, and no experimental cleverness changes that -- it is a DELIVERABLE ruling, not an experiment. The paradigm lane also PRE-KILLED two candidates at $0: PK-1 prior-matched transductive batch assignment (Sinkhorn/OT over the test batch) is ARITHMETICALLY a quantile threshold on a 1-D score and is therefore capped below F88's already-measured-dead test-FITTED threshold oracle (ZH +0.0201), with F89-T1 additionally degenerate; PK-2 Pairwise Difference Learning (arXiv:2406.20031) is the canonical named form of F95's dead route, a decode variant inside a family whose control 2 failed 0/36, worth ~10 CPU-minutes only if the family must be closed BY NAME in the paper. || LIMITATIONS CARRIED HONESTLY: (1) raw space, train split, not the deployed head space and not test (F95 L1, inherited) -- a raw-space null does not logically entail a head-space null, and this cuts AGAINST the negative verdict; it is mitigated but not removed by K-VGA-3 being a RELATIVE comparison between two feature families in the SAME arena under the SAME protocol, which is far less arena-sensitive than an absolute Dacc; (2) single verifier seed, single fold draw (MLP_SEED=0, FOLD_SEED=0) -- the GATE's variance is controlled by inner CV plus a 200-draw permutation null, the VERIFIER's is not; (3) residual coupling in the nesting, declared in advance: the gate never sees the fold it scores, but its training items' FEATURES were produced by F95 verifiers whose fit sets included that fold's items; a doubly-nested verifier (25 fits per dataset instead of 5) would remove it and was not run -- the bias direction would if anything FLATTER the verifier arm, which lost anyway; (4) the gate can only act on the DISAGREEMENT SET, so the oracle ceiling is the hard maximum for the whole family -- a design property correctly priced BEFORE the run, not a discovered limitation; (5) two gate model families, one operating-point rule, one gate-target definition -- a precision-targeting threshold rule is unmeasured, though the required-precision arithmetic bounds what it could buy; (6) C2's baselines are FITTED (both VNQ and kNN-UE get the same nested logistic so the comparison isolates the feature family, not the combiner) -- and the UNFITTED plain vote margin still won, which makes the fitting choice non-load-bearing; (7) C3 (VEA) is a writing task, untouched here; C4 (VSW) not tasked, not run; (8) NO test-fitted quantity appears anywhere -- no test label, no test split loaded by any script, no oracle used for any operating point (the oracle arm is a reported ceiling only).

body: PRINCIPLE UNDER TEST: LITSWEEP6 membank-C3. The deployed decision is v = sum_i (2*lab_i-1)*cos_i*w_i / sum_i w_i over the top-20 own-train neighbours with w = [20,19,...,1], predict 1 iff v >= 0. C3 keeps retrieval, the key space, k=20, the candidate set, the threshold and the label field IDENTICAL and changes ONLY the weighting, and changes it PER QUERY: v = sum_i s_i*cos_i*g_theta(profile)_i / sum_i g_theta(profile)_i, g_theta >= 0. Its entire licence was F94's closure of the GLOBAL-k axis in both directions -- only a CONDITIONAL, NON-MONOTONE weighting can express something no single global k can. || PROFILE, declared in full, with NO verifier feature anywhere (F97's K-VGA-3 measured them dead as a signal source, and that is binding on this record): 60-d PRIMARY = cos_1..20 in deployed rank order + s_1..20 signed neighbour labels + pfx_1..20 purity-prefix (1/i)*sum_{j<=i} lab_j; a SECONDARY arm adds a 20-d Delta-length block. The rank-1 margin, the vote itself, purity and the label ratio are all deterministic functions of this profile, hence inside the class. || NETWORK: Linear(d,16) -> tanh -> Linear(16,20) -> softplus, 1316 params at d=60, with DEPLOYED-ANCHORED INITIALISATION (output weights zero, output bias = softplus^-1(w_i/w_1)) so that at epoch 0 the arm is BIT-IDENTICAL to the floor; loss = BCEWithLogits(v,y) + lambda*(||W_out||^2 + ||b_out - b_deployed||^2) with lambda selected by an INNER StratifiedKFold(5, random_state=17) inside the fitting pool over {1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10,100}, ties broken toward the LARGEST lambda -- so lambda -> inf returns the deployed rule EXACTLY and lambda -> 0 the free conditional net. That shrinkage is IN THE FREEZE, not a later repair, because sec2.6 measured on synthetic data BEFORE the freeze that without it the harness is structurally incapable of returning an honest null (an unregularised 1316-param net on 560 examples destroyed a deployed-OPTIMAL rule by -0.1714). v is invariant to positive rescaling of g, so the net cannot manufacture confidence by inflating magnitudes. || ARENA: banked RAW encoder key space (fused PRIMARY, text/img SECONDARY), TRAIN SPLIT ONLY, the F95 harness verbatim (StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0), item-disjoint, floor = mechfix_ops.deployed_vote). GATES: 81/81 parity cells at 4dp against F95's recorded train-side numbers (pooled acc + pooled mF1 + 5 per-fold acc + n_deployed_wrong + n_pathology_pop, over 3 spaces, 27 per dataset); IMPL gate 45/45 asserting the C3 vote engine at the constant profile [20..1] is BIT-FOR-BIT equal to the deployed vote in votes, predictions and the retrieved index matrix, so the treatment differs from the floor in the WEIGHTING AND NOTHING ELSE; plus a free determinism gate (52 quantities per dataset identical across two independent processes). PRE-FREEZE SELFTEST, synthetic only: arm A (two populations needing OPPOSITE monotone treatments, keyed by the rank-1 margin) recovered EXACTLY (+0.5429, acc 1.0000, 45.7% non-monotone); arm C (deployed rule already optimal) returned the floor BIT-EXACTLY (0.0000, lambda=100); arm B (neighbourhood says nothing about y) is NOT a null -- C3 lands on exactly the majority-class rate, which is the pre-registered proof that its function class contains the prior predictor and very nearly the FULL class of classifiers of the profile. Floors (fused): HateMM n=744 0.8441/0.8419, 116 wrong, 88 pathology; MHC-ZH n=579 0.8480/0.8281, 88 wrong, 79 pathology; MHC-EN n=549 0.7796/0.7286, 121 wrong, 109 pathology. || COVERAGE AND CEILING -- THE LOAD-BEARING NUMBER OF THIS FINDING: a non-negative weighting can flip sign(v) only where the top-20 is class-MIXED, which is 0.8683 / 0.8290 / 0.9709 of items (HateMM/ZH/EN); deployed errors REACHABLE = 111/116, 88/88, 120/121 = 96-100%; FAMILY ORACLE Dacc = +0.1492 / +0.1520 / +0.2186. That is 2-4x the F95/VGA adjudication-gate oracle (+0.0726/+0.0535/+0.0893) and 10-15x F94's per-seed oracle-k ceiling (+0.0145 max over six arms). C3 ENTERED THIS PREGATE WITH BY FAR THE LARGEST ORACLE CEILING ANY MEMBER OF THIS FAMILY HAS EVER HAD. || RESULT (fused, pooled over all held-out train items): PRIMARY C3_net = +0.0134 HateMM (fold signs -0+++, 22 fixed / 12 broken on 34 changed items of 744, ER 1.8333) / -0.0069 MHC-ZH (ER 0.8400, 46 changed) / +0.0000 MHC-EN (2 items changed). Across ALL 45 C3 cells (3 datasets x 3 spaces x 5 C3 arms): 17 positive, 8 exactly zero, 20 negative; MAXIMUM ANYWHERE +0.0134; ZERO of 45 reach +0.030. Secondary spaces rescue nothing (PRIMARY is negative in 3/3 ZH spaces). Even a shopped 15-way per-dataset maximum -- reported as an upper bound, not a result -- gives only +0.0134 / +0.0069 / +0.0036. || DECISIVE BAR K-C3-P, frozen verbatim before the run: Dacc > +0.030 on >=1 dataset with >=4/5 fold signs AND MATERIALLY ABOVE the +0.0269 F47-gate benchmark on that dataset. MEASURED: best C3 cell anywhere = +0.0134 -- MISSED BY MORE THAN A FACTOR OF TWO -- and on HateMM it lands 0.0135 BELOW the benchmark it had to exceed (VGA's f47ctrl_full:gbm, +0.0269, 36 fixed / 16 broken, ER 2.25, p=0.0050, signs +++++, re-read from vga_pregate_OUT.json). THE RICHER FUNCTION CLASS EXTRACTED LESS OF THE FAMILY ORACLE THAN THE CHEAP GATE DID, which is the exact question the tasking posed. || BOTH MANDATORY DEGENERACY CONTROLS FIRE, on the ONLY dataset where C3 is positive, against a frozen <0.95 line: DEG-A, pooled agreement with a bare GLOBAL DECISION-THRESHOLD SHIFT = 0.9570 (HateMM) and 0.9508 (EN); DEG-B, agreement with a SINGLE FIXED k from F94's grid = 0.9610 at k=15 (HateMM) and 0.9964 at k=20 (EN -- i.e. C3 simply IS the deployed rule there). The arithmetic that makes this decisive rather than a technicality: THRESH_best ALONE scores +0.0188 on HateMM -- MORE THAN C3 -- using no network, no profile and no conditioning; and DIRECT_logit, an unconstrained logistic readout of the IDENTICAL profile (DEG-C), scores +0.0134, EXACTLY C3's number, at 0.9516 agreement. The aggregation FORM contributes nothing that either of its two degenerate twins does not already contribute. || WHAT C3 ACTUALLY LEARNED (bar 3, which does NOT fire by its letter): 0.9960 / 0.9585 / 0.3461 of emitted profiles are non-monotone, and on HateMM ALL 34 changed decisions sit on non-monotone profiles -- but the MEAN learned profile is [2.0086, 0.9602, 0.7991, 0.7559, ...] on HateMM and [2.0161, 1.0259, 0.8747, ...] on ZH, i.e. DOUBLE THE RANK-1 WEIGHT AND OTHERWISE THE DEPLOYED DECAY, UNMOVED. That is a GLOBAL re-shaping with a small conditional ripple on top, not the 'conditionally trust rank 1' rule the licence was written for -- and a steeper FIXED profile (exp0.7, pow1.0, k7) is already inside the bar-2 family, which is why the bar-2 margin is only +0.0161 and why DEG-B reads 0.96. The per-query MONOTONE twin C3_metak (softmax mixture over F94's eight k-profiles) delivers +0.0040 / -0.0155 / -0.0018, so non-monotonicity is worth about +0.009 on HateMM and nothing elsewhere. || OTHER BARS: bar 2 (must beat the best FIXED MONOTONE profile chosen on the fitting folds, the anti-profile-tuning control) PASSES 2/3 at +0.0161 / +0.0069 / -0.0036 -- but it is a LOW bar, because FIXBEST_mono is itself NEGATIVE on two datasets (-0.0027 / -0.0138) and a different family member wins in every fold of every dataset: picking a fixed profile on the fitting folds actively COSTS accuracy. bar 4a exchange rate PASSES 1/3 -- HateMM 1.8333, above the 1.2 bar, above F95's 1.1667 ceiling over 36 cells and above every C1 cell (0.2647-0.9474), the campaign's first TREATMENT arm buying fixes at better than par on a dataset where it also moves accuracy; the +dlen arm reaches 2.1250 at 5/5 signs -- but it buys them on 34 items of 744, which is exactly what prices a 1.83 exchange rate at +0.0134. ZH 0.8400 FAILS; EN 1.0000 on 2 items is not interpretable. bar 4b class balance PASSES (max deviation from bank rate 0.0455, no collapse anywhere -- unlike C1's drift to 0.5181/0.5501 against bank 0.31), which is what licenses reading the other bars as measurements rather than artefacts. Nested lambda selection never picks the free end of the grid for the PRIMARY arm and picks heavy shrinkage on EN (1.0 in 3 folds); on ZH stability seeds it picks lambda=100 -- 'be the deployed rule' outright -- in 2 of 5 folds. || BOUNDARY HONESTY, stated so it is visible rather than hidden: the PRIMARY arm misses LITSWEEP6 bar 1's 5/5 fold-sign clause BY ONE FOLD at +0.0134 (two of three stability seeds read 0++++ at +0.0121/+0.0134, and the SECONDARY +dlen arm reads +++++ at +0.0121; under the freeze neither can carry a bar). The honest reading is that C3 sits RIGHT AT the weak +0.010 interest line and NOWHERE NEAR the +0.030 decision bar. NOTHING ABOUT THE KILL TURNS ON THAT ONE FOLD SIGN. || PERMUTATION NULL -- PASSED ON ALL THREE AND UNINFORMATIVE ON ALL THREE, recorded as a design lesson so it is not repeated: N_PERM=100, PERM_SEED=12345, fitting-fold targets shuffled (bank labels, retrieval and held-out labels untouched), the FULL nested pipeline including inner-CV lambda selection re-run per draw, PRIMARY arm x PRIMARY space. p = 0.0099 on all three, the smallest the design can produce -- but NOT ONE OF THE 300 NULL DRAWS REACHED ZERO (maxima -0.0323 / -0.0259 / -0.0109; means -0.1063 / -0.1063 / -0.0523). With shuffled targets the inner CV argmaxes over seven noisy uninformative estimates, lands on a small lambda roughly at random, and the refit is dragged 5-16 accuracy points below the floor -- so ANY arm that merely FALLS BACK TO THE FLOOR scores p=0.0099 automatically. MHC-EN is the unambiguous proof: 2 items changed, Dacc EXACTLY +0.0000, and 'significant at p=0.0099'. The test discharges only 'the fitted rule beats a rule fitted to shuffled labels' -- made nearly automatic by the deployed-anchored fallback -- and does NOT discharge 'the fitted rule beats the deployed floor', which is what bar 2, DEG-A/B and DEG-C test and what the verdict rests on. Contrast VGA, where the same test WAS informative precisely because its fallback ('fire on nothing', net exactly 0) was REACHABLE by the null, whose means were -0.0024 to -0.0072, and the primary arm consequently returned honest non-significance (p = 0.8706 / 0.5174 / 0.9751). A more informative null for an arm with a floor fallback would shuffle targets AND force the same lambda, or compare against the floor. || WHY THE KILL IS MECHANISTIC RATHER THAN BUDGETARY: the standing alternative explanation for every previous member of this family was 'the operator could not reach the errors'. C3 REMOVES IT. 96-100% of every deployed error is inside its reach; its function class is very nearly the full class of profile classifiers (selftest arm B); the harness provably recovers a genuine conditional weighting EXACTLY (arm A) and provably returns the floor bit-exactly when there is nothing to find (arm C) -- and it still converged, on the one dataset where it moved at all, to a GLOBAL THRESHOLD SHIFT and a FIXED k=15 VOTE, both already-closed levers, one of which outscores it while using no network. WITHIN THIS FAMILY DELIVERY IS UNCORRELATED WITH CEILING, and C3 is the datum that establishes it: F94 global-k ceiling +0.0145 -> delivered -0.0140..+0.0041; F95/VGA adjudication gate ceiling +0.0726/+0.0535/+0.0893 -> delivered +0.0269/+0.0104/+0.0182; C3 conditional weighting ceiling +0.1492/+0.1520/+0.2186 -> delivered +0.0134/-0.0069/+0.0000. What binds is neither REACH nor CAPACITY: THE LOCAL CONFIGURATION DOES NOT CARRY A LEARNABLE SIGNAL ABOUT WHICH NEIGHBOURS TO TRUST at n=549-744, and the +0.0269 F47 gate is the whole of what this information object is worth -- a number that was already banked before this pregate ran. || FAMILY CLOSURE, recorded as the tasking required. This is the SECOND INDEPENDENT OPERATOR collapsing to a threshold-shift-in-costume after F96 (C1 agreed with a pure global threshold shift on 95.03 / 97.75 / 99.45% of items and was killed on that alone, regardless of its Dacc). Two different halves of the vote -- the LABEL FIELD (F96) and the WEIGHTING (F98) -- edited two different ways, degenerate to the same place. THE CONDITIONAL-AGGREGATION FAMILY IS THEREFORE CLOSED as one settled axis: F95 pair-verification replacing the vote (-0.0040/-0.0466/-0.0146 ungated), VGA C1 gating that replacement (K-VGA-3 fired: the F47 features BEAT the verifier features 3/3), VGA C2/VNQ reading the same profile as a risk ordering (loses to the FREE deployed vote margin on all three), and C3 learning the weighting. Its ONLY positive remains the F47-feature adjudication gate at +0.0269 / +0.0104 / +0.0182 (p = 0.0050 / 0.0050 / 0.0100) -- below the +0.030 bar on all three, gating an adjudicator that is net-negative ungated, and already ruled ANALYSIS-GRADE ONLY. || ERRATUM-STRENGTH SHARPENING OF F96, to be carried forward with the number from here on: RESTRANS's dead relative D1 (logistic(deployed vote, log(1+volume)) -> gold, a query-side score-level length de-bias) produced this campaign's first above-bar exchange rates on HateMM, +0.0215 acc / ER 1.8889 (fused) and +0.0282 / 2.2353 (text), and F96 attributed the effect to the LENGTH COVARIATE. THRESH_best in this record is the SAME OPERATOR WITH THE COVARIATE REMOVED -- a bare global threshold on the deployed vote, no features at all -- and measures +0.0188 / ER 1.5833 (fused) and +0.0242 / ER 1.7200 (text) in the identical arena and protocol. The covariate is therefore worth +0.0027 / +0.0040, about 2-3 items: D1'S POSITIVE IS ~87% A BARE DECISION-THRESHOLD MOVE, NOT A LENGTH DE-BIAS. This does not change F96's verdict but removes the last optimistic reading of it, and it is the mechanical reason DEG-A fires: on HateMM's TRAIN arena the deployed vote's threshold is simply mis-set, and any sufficiently flexible operator -- a length logistic, a bare threshold, or a 1316-parameter conditional aggregator -- converges to the same correction. Three independent measurements now agree, and the lever remains MEASURED DEAD in the deployed head space on TEST (ERRPAT-HateMM sec2.1: +0.0000 / +0.0016). It is a diagnostic about the train arena, not a lever; it should stop being re-derived. || ROUTING: no GPU, no promotion, no ceremony -- no arm approaches the house bar and both mandatory degeneracy controls fire. LITSWEEP6's ACCURACY MENU IS NOW 0-FOR-3 AT $0 (F96 restrans, F97 VGA/VNQ, F98 aggnet). NOT closed by this entry, and the boundary is stated precisely because it is meant to be usable: LITSWEEP6 C4 (aggregate-then-compare subspace residual) -- its input is the retrieved VECTORS, not their cosine/label profile, so it is outside C3's function class by INFORMATION CONTENT and not merely by functional form; and LITSWEEP6 C2 (cell-conditional synthesis into the bank) -- the only operator left that changes MEMBERSHIP, i.e. which items are retrievable at all, though its prereg must first be rewritten so its placement criterion does not use p_hat (F96 sec6). LITSWEEP6 C5 (per-entry STATIC reliability weights alpha_i) is not formally inside the closure (alpha_i keys on bank-item identity, which C3's rank-indexed profile cannot see) but is STRONGLY DOWNGRADED by this result -- it is the query-INDEPENDENT special case of an operator with a 96-100% ceiling that delivered ~0 -- and is recommended DROPPED as a performance candidate, retained only as pillar-4 auditability material. || LIMITATIONS CARRIED HONESTLY: (1) banked RAW encoder key space, TRAIN split, NOT the deployed head space and NOT test (the F95 L1 limitation inherited by both sibling pregates; F47's head LOO train acc 0.998 makes any train-side head-space screen a memorisation read) -- a raw-space train-side null does not logically entail a head-space or test null, and this cuts AGAINST the negative verdict; it is mitigated, not removed, by the fact that every bar that actually FIRES here is a RELATIVE comparison inside ONE arena under ONE protocol (C3 vs the best fixed monotone profile, vs a global threshold shift, vs a fixed k, vs its own label-shuffled null), and relative comparisons are far less arena-sensitive than an absolute Dacc; (2) NO seeds in the arena -- raw features are seed-independent, so the sign evidence is 5 FOLDS, not 3 seeds; the network's own initialisation seed is varied (0 PRIMARY, 1 and 2 as a stability read that cannot carry a bar), which controls fitting variance but not fold-draw variance; (3) ONE fold draw, FOLD_SEED=0, the frozen F95 assignment, no outer resampling; (4) train-side only and NO test quantity exists in the document by design, so the ERRPAT stable-core id lists could not be used as the exchange-rate population and the F95 train-side pathology definition (deployed-wrong held-out items whose nearest same-gold-class bank item is within rank 5) substitutes; (5) ONE network family, one loss, one epoch budget (300 full-batch Adam epochs at lr 1e-2, only lambda selected on a nested 7-point grid) -- a different architecture, a margin loss or a learned-temperature readout are unmeasured, and what BOUNDS the value of that unmeasured space is selftest arm B: the function class is already nearly the full class of profile classifiers, so capacity is measured NOT to be the missing ingredient; (6) the Delta-length profile block is SECONDARY and its covariate is measured dead on 2 of 3 datasets (F96 sec6: rho +0.2842 HateMM, -0.1152 ZH sign-inverted, -0.0050 p=0.906 EN); (7) N_PERM=100 rather than VGA's 200 because each draw re-runs 31 network fits, so p-resolution is 1/101 -- and independently of resolution the null tests the wrong proposition for an arm with a floor fallback (see above); (8) NO test-split file was opened, no test label read, no oracle used to choose anything -- FIXBEST_oracle and the family ceiling are REPORTED CEILINGS computed on held-out TRAIN items, never used to select an arm or an operating point. Also DISCLOSED IN THE RECORD RATHER THAN SILENTLY FIXED: an erratum withdrawing a pre-freeze claim ('selftest arm A reaches perfect accuracy at lambda=1.0 with 0% non-monotone profiles') that came from a SUPERSEDED pre-freeze harness iteration using a naive weight_decay regulariser; in the frozen script arm A selects lambda=0.01 with 45.71% non-monotone profiles and lambda>=0.1 does not solve the task at all. NO BAR CHANGED, and the argument the withdrawn number supported now rests on a definitional point plus the measured C3_metak arm.

title: RDK $0 forensic recon -- RELATIONAL DISTILLATION INTO THE KEY SPACE (train a map on banked keys so cosine geometry reproduces the F95 pair-verifier's relation geometry; deployed vote untouched): PRE-CLOSED at recon, ALIVE ONLY BEHIND A RULING, D7-DEAD ON THE CLAIM -- and the transferable output is a NEW ARITHMETIC BOUND, the pure-permutation oracle
body: Record refine-logs/RDK_FORENSIC_RECON.md. THIS IS A RECON-LEVEL PRE-CLOSURE, NOT A MEASURED KILL: nothing was run, no frozen script, no bar. Cost $0: CPU reading + forensic arithmetic only; ZERO GPU / SLURM / Modal / training; TEST-SPLIT CONTACT NONE. || BAN RULINGS, one by one. F66 NOT BINDING (phi_0-conditional; NCA_FORENSIC_RECON.md:110 already ruled 'F66 does NOT bind trained-space reshaping' and RDK produces a new map hence a new Gram matrix). F75/NCA PARTIALLY -> EFFECTIVELY BINDING ON THE SHARED-MAP FORM: LITSWEEP6_MEMBANK.md:707-710 draws the one-sidedness line itself ('INK ... move the datastore keys ONE-SIDEDLY ... which is genuinely not NCA (F75, which applies one shared map to both sides)'), and RDK as specified applies ONE SHARED MAP TO BOTH SIDES, i.e. it falls on NCA's side; worse, the verifier it distils was fitted on 'Verifier target y = 1[lab_i == lab_j]' (MECHNOV_PAIRVERIFY_PREGATE.md:188) -- the SAME label-agreement matrix NCA optimises. RDK is NCA with a two-stage estimator. F89/T2b PARTIALLY BINDING: RDK's mechanism IS T2b's cone de-collapse move done with labels instead of a closed-form whitener (MECHFIX_PREGATE_2026-07-27.md:238 'train top-1 sim 0.9999 -> 0.5220'), and T2b raised the length-nuisance Spearman from 0.52 to 0.87 mean on HateMM (:288-289, per-dataset table :276-280). F94 ALONE NOT BINDING (it is about depth, not metric) BUT F94 AND F98 JOINTLY EFFECTIVELY BINDING: with the top-20 SET essentially unchanged, RDK's realisable channel is a per-item RE-WEIGHTING of a fixed top-20 = exactly F98's function class, oracle +0.1492/+0.1520/+0.2186 (AGGNET_PREGATE_RECORD.md:368-370) and realised +0.0134/-0.0069/+0.0000 (:682). D7 BINDING ON THE CLAIM: REDTEAM_BAN_SCOPE_AUDIT.md GAP-7 rules the head/key-map class out 'on D7 (adds no MLLM role -> generic classifier tuning)' (:303-306). Training-signal bans [1]/[5]/[6] NOT BINDING on the letter (the teacher is our own verifier on gold TRAIN labels, not an MLLM score and not a gold annotation). C5's teacher-as-key ceiling rule (C5_FORENSIC_RECON.md:133-135) BINDS AS A PRECONDITION: transposed, RDK's ceiling is using the verifier's relation DIRECTLY inside the retrieval weighting = VSW (LITSWEEP6_RELGEN.md:256-297), which VGA_PREGATE_RECORD.md:446 records as 'not tasked and not run'. RDK's oracle is therefore UNMEASURED and VSW is its precondition. || AN ARGUMENT RECORDED AS INVALID, so it is never reused: killing RDK on 'only 26.6-37.7% interaction share' is WRONG THREE TIMES -- (i) 26.6-37.7% is the COSINE's share (MECHNOV_PAIRVERIFY_PREGATE.md:431-432); the VERIFIER's is 77-93% (:433-434; per-dataset 0.9329/0.7895/0.7745 at :425,427,429), so the figure argues FOR the cell; (ii) an ANOVA main/interaction split says nothing about bilinear representability; (iii) it was never measured on the student map. THE VALID PROXY, re-derived this session from MECHNOV_PAIRVERIFY_PREGATE.md:268-270: the LOGISTIC arm -- 'a label-supervised diagonal re-metric' by that record's own words (:107) -- captures 0.676/0.643/0.722 = 64-72% of the MLP's pair-AUC advantage over the raw cosine. A metric-shaped student CAN carry most of the relation; representability is NOT the kill. || NEW DERIVED ARITHMETIC WORTH PRESERVING -- THE PURE-PERMUTATION ORACLE (elementary, reproducible by hand). With w=[20..1], Sigma w = 210, decision [s>=0], and the measured cone collapse (ERRPAT_HateMM_2026-07-26.md:139-141 'cosine is saturated at ~0.9999 ... the head space is collapsed onto a narrow cone'), all twenty cosines are equal to first order, so sign(s) = sign(Sigma_j w_j sigma_j). The BEST permutation puts the m true-class neighbours at the head: Sigma w sigma = 2*(21m - m(m+1)/2) - 210 >= 0 iff m(41-m) >= 210. HATE query: first holds at m=6 (6*35=210, the tie, resolved toward hate by [s>=0]) => flippable iff purity >= 6/20 = 0.30. NON-HATE query: needs STRICT s<0, k(41-k) > 210 first holds at k=7 (7*34=238; k=6 gives exactly 210 and fails) => flippable iff purity >= 7/20 = 0.35. BELOW purity 6/20 NO permutation of the retrieved list -- hence no set-preserving re-metrication -- can flip the prediction. CROSSED WITH THE MEASURED ERROR PURITY: HateMM has 'purity <0.25 for 21/27' errors (ERRPAT_HateMM_2026-07-26.md:143-144) => at most 6 of 27 are permutation-flippable => <= 6/215 = +0.0279; MHC-ZH's 22-item stable core is '8 at <=0.10, 7 in (0.10,0.25], 7 in (0.25,0.45], and zero above 0.45' (ERRPAT_MHC-ZH_2026-07-26.md:222-223) => at most 7 => <= 7/149 = +0.0470. n=215/149 per PAPER_MASTER_TABLES.md:418 and MECHFIX_PREGATE_2026-07-27.md:303.
